in_sanskrit.name: भानुमित्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भास्करात्मा (Bhaskaratma) or सूर्यपुत्र (Suryaputra) - भानु (Bhanu) meaning Sun and मित्र (Mitra) meaning friend or ally. So, Bhanumitra is a name meaning 'Sun's friend' or 'Alliance with the Sun'.

in_marathi.name: Bhanumitra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon Goddess's bridge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhanumitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhanumitra is a combination of two Sanskrit words - ‘Bhanu’ (Moon) and ‘Mitra’ (Friend or Bridge). The name suggests that the person is the bridge between the celestial world and the earthly realm, connecting the spiritual and the mundane.

in_bengali.name: Bhanumitra

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhanumitra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhanumitra is a combination of two Sanskrit words - ‘Bhanu’ (Moon) and ‘Mitra’ (Friend or Bridge). The name suggests that the person is the bridge between the celestial world and the earthly realm, connecting the spiritual and the mundane.
